_comment: RECOMMENDED tapered-wedge HFOFO design ('taperB2', Phase T2): nominal optics with the LiH wedge width shaped along the channel -- start 0.8x, linear ramp to 4.2x (period 30), plus a +0.5 triangular mid-channel bump (ws_i = 0.8 + 3.4*frac + 0.5*tri). Thin early to protect the hot beam, extra material mid-channel where the beam is already compact, thickest at the end. Validated 400 events x 3 seeds vs nominal/taperA at identical statistics: T=0.606+/-0.014 with exit eps6D=95.8+/-18.4 vs taperA 129+/-32 and nominal 187+/-38 mm^3 -- better cooling than taperA in every seed at the same transmission; exit brightness 1.82x nominal. Requires NO optics/RF changes. Supersedes the linear 'taperA' (Phase T). See also optimized_taper_hiT.json ('taperC') for T=0.624 at eps6D=103+/-23. Apply: python ../optimization/apply_design.py hfofo.in optimized_taper.json
